'''Ederlathh Pallopides''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the remote great-niece of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], ruler of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the power struggle that ensued after Palpatine's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a faction of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] backed Pallopides's hereditary rights to her great-uncle's [[Imperial throne|throne]]. In reality, she was a political pawn in [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Betl Oxtroe]]'s plan to reunite the [[Imperial Civil War|fractured]] Empire by using Pallopides as a figurehead [[Empress/Legends|Empress]].

==Biography==
Ederlath Pallopides was born in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], roughly four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. At the age of eleven, Pallopides was presented to the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] as the great-niece of the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Betl Oxtroe]], a [[Imperial officer/Legends|high-ranking officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. By this time, the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] had been going badly for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="des" /> since the loss of its leader in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="EpisodeVI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

With the Empire in [[Imperial Civil War|decline]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;the successor state of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&mdash;in the ascent, Admiral Oxtroe attempted to end the war through diplomacy before the Empire lost [[Imperial Military/Legends|what remained of its ability]] to negotiate an outcome other than unconditional surrender. Hence, Oxtroe made overtures to the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] and proposed to reform the Empire into a constitutional [[King/Legends|monarchy]].<ref name="des" />

Thus, she intended to install Pallopides on the vacant [[Imperial throne]] as the first [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] of the Galactic Empire. As a child, however, Pallopides could only rule as a symbolic figurehead while actual governmental authority was wielded by more experienced officials. As such, Admiral Oxtroe offered the position of [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] to the members of the Provisional [[Council]]. This arrangement would then place the Empire under joint Imperial-Republic rule, although actual leadership of the new government would be controlled by the Council in its [[Advisor/Legends|advisory]] role to Empress Pallopides.<ref name="des" />

Ultimately, the Admiral's vision for the New Galactic Empire was never realized. Before her negotiations could be taken any further with the Council, she was killed by unidentified [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], although later New Republic accounts implicated the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] for the assassination of Betl Oxtroe. As a result, Pallopides did not succeed her alleged great-uncle as the next ruler of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="des" /> The Empire itself continued to decline at an accelerated rate, dwindling into a [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|small remnant of its former glory]]. By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Empire&mdash;what little remained of it&mdash;[[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|effectively surrendered]] to the New Republic, thus concluding the [[civil war]] that engulfed the galaxy for roughly two decades.<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Ederlathh Pallopides was one<ref name="des" /> of the select few [[Gender/Legends|females]] of note in the highly male-dominated [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Humanocentrism|centric]] Galactic Empire,<ref name="negtc">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> although her position was primarily owed to her alleged [[DNA/Legends|blood]] [[House Palpatine/Legends|connection]] to Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="des" /> Despite the fact that the Empire lacked an official policy regarding hereditary succession, especially given how the Emperor secretly intended to rule indefinitely through [[Cloning/Legends|cloned versions]] of [[Clone template/Legends|himself]],<ref name="de">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref> Pallopides's status as Palpatine's great-niece made her a natural candidate for the Imperial throne in Admiral Betl Oxtroe's opinion.<ref name="des" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ederlathh Pallopides was first mentioned in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', authored by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published in [[1993]]. Although Pallopides was identified as the great-niece of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="des" /> the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] revealed that Palpatine murdered the members of his immediate family, including his [[Palpatine's siblings|younger siblings]]. However, the same novel also mentioned that Palpatine's father, [[Cosinga Palpatine]], also had an extramarital affair with a [[Cosinga Palpatine's mistress|mistress]], leaving open the possibility of her lineage to Palpatine being valid.<ref name="plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
